scope: Selected filter-parameter cells: Table 8 and Table 10 predictor parameters, Table 11 CCITTFaxDecode parameters, and Table 12 JBIG2Globals. This is an assertion-quality review, not certification of the complete filter clauses or codecs.

source.errata: Checked the primary EC3 PDF and annotation context. No substantive erratum was identified for these parameter-cell rules. This does not imply surrounding clauses or referenced codec standards were exhaustively audited.

source_rules: Predictor defaults to 1 (no prediction); values greater than 1 select prediction.
Colors, BitsPerComponent, and Columns are prediction parameters with defaults 1, 8, and 1. Table 8 lists the supported bit depths and version condition for 16-bit samples.
EarlyChange applies to LZW: 0 delays width growth until the table is full, 1 increases one code earlier; default is 1.

assertions.oracle: Literal decoded bytes for omitted Predictor/default predictor and two-color PNG None/Sub/Up rows; Flate and LZW entry points both exercised.
Independent packed code stream and literal expected bytes cross all code widths and full-table clear/reset for EarlyChange 0, 1, and omitted default 1.
Hand-authored exact sample bytes cover TIFF Predictor 2, sub-byte and 16-bit handling, and PNG functions; individual tests must be read for the specific branch claimed.

cells.coverage_assessment: Good selected decoder evidence for defaults, representative PNG/TIFF reconstruction, and LZW width transitions. Not a full cartesian matrix of Colors/BPC/Columns or every legal versioned image use.
residuals: Indirect numeric values in DecodeParms are separately audited as B54; the two recorded indirect Predictor/Columns cases fail while direct controls pass. Do not report them as untested or duplicate the tests.
Table 8 predictor-specific version restrictions are not all demonstrated by the decoder tests; conformance of PDF producer inputs and parser's version policy are distinct questions.

source_rules: 1 is no prediction (default); 2 is TIFF Predictor 2; 10 selects PNG prediction with None row filter; 11–15 select the named PNG row algorithms. For Predictor >=10 the encoded row tag identifies the row algorithm, so a value such as 10 does not require all rows to use None.
assertions: flate_lzw_spec_audit::table8_defaults_and_png_row_tags_reach_both_decoders has literal mixed None/Sub/Up rows under Predictor 10 for both codecs
filters.rs contains per-algorithm predictor tests with explicit expected reconstructed bytes
cells.coverage_assessment: The mixed row-tag fixture directly witnesses the rule that PNG tags select individual row functions. Review is selective and does not certify every row filter against all channel widths and sample depths.
residuals: No new draft was warranted after the existing exact-byte assertions were inspected; no shared production evaluator is used as the expected-byte oracle.

source_rules: K sign selects Group 4, Group 3 1D, or Group 3 mixed mode; positive magnitudes are not distinct modes. Default 0.
EOL is accepted; EndOfLine=true specifies that EOL is present in the encoded input. EncodedByteAlign=true skips fill to the next byte boundary before each encoded line. Defaults false.
Columns gives encoded pixel width (default 1728); for unencoded width not divisible by eight, width is padded to the next byte boundary.

Rows=0/absent means no predetermined line count (default 0). With EndOfBlock=false, decode stops after Rows or input exhaustion. With EndOfBlock=true (default), the appropriate RTC/EOFB terminates decoding and takes precedence over Rows.
BlackIs1 reverses the PDF default sample polarity; default false.
DamagedRowsBeforeError defaults 0 and applies only when EndOfLine=true and K>=0; eligible damaged rows are replaced by previous clean row or white when no previous clean row is available.

assertions.oracle: Direct decoder line count on streams with valid Group 3/Group 4 delimiters; not a public image assertion.
Same valid encoded bytes yield exact complementary output bitmaps under opposite BlackIs1 values.
Public reader exercise for EndOfBlock=false row bound and shortfall report; blanking remainder is project rendering policy, not specified output by Table 11.
Controls test applicability and previous-row/white replacement using hand-encoded line data.

cells.coverage_assessment: New valid EOFB public-reader test PASS. Parent strengthened two equal black rows into distinct black upper and white lower rows, with Rows1/Rows2 controls and literal opaque pixels.
residuals: The existing `end_of_block_true_ignores_a_short_rows_and_draws_the_whole_image` fixture has no Group 3 RTC; it is not a valid EOB positive control. It should not substantiate delimiter handling.

The relationship between image Height and filter termination for mismatched malformed or short data is not resolved by this valid fixture. No reader rejection duty is inferred from EndOfLine's producer-side presence condition.
No reviewed assertion compares distinct positive K values on the same valid mixed-mode bytes; this narrow equivalence is residual, not a claimed defect.

source_rules: Optional value is a stream of JBIG2 global/page-0 segments; such segments are kept in this separate stream even when only one image refers to them, and the stream may be shared.

The published example does not supply a complete target bitmap, so structural pixel checks are not described as an exact sample oracle.
Table 12's wrong-type behavior does not specify a mandatory reader rejection in the text reviewed; no failure is inferred.
